definitions.MTTA: Mean of acknowledgedAt − detectedAt over acknowledged incidents; unacknowledged ones are excluded and counted.
definitions.MTTR: Mean of verifiedHealthyAt − detectedAt over incidents whose recovery was verified by health checks; runbook completion is not used.
definitions.Availability: Healthy probes ÷ probes received in the range (Nginx over HTTP, not EC2 running). Minutes without a probe are unknown.
definitions.Percentiles: Median when n ≥ 3; p90 (nearest rank) when n ≥ 10.

dataQuality: Probes cover 1% of this range; minutes without a probe are unknown, not counted as up or down.
1 incident(s) have no verified recovery and are excluded from MTTR.
